statusLine.command: input=$(cat); d=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); b=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$b" ] || b=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); gd=''; if [ -n "$b" ]; then for r in origin/HEAD origin/main origin/master main master; do if git -C "$d" rev-parse -q --verify "$r^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then gd=$(git -C "$d" diff --numstat "$r...HEAD" 2>/dev/null | awk '{a+=$1; x+=$2} END {printf "+%d -%d", a, x}'); break; fi; done; fi; printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r --arg b "$b" --arg gd "$gd" '[([.model.display_name, .effort.level] | map(select(. != null and . != "")) | join(" ")), "v\(.version)", (.session_name // "unnamed"), $b, $gd, ([(.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty | {k: "c", v: (100 - round)}), (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty | {k: "w", v: (100 - round)})] | if length == 0 then empty else "\(map("\(.v)%") | join(" / ")) left \(map(.k) | join("/"))" end),"ID: \(.session_id[0:36])", (if (env.CLAUDE_JOB_DIR // "") == "" then empty else "BG" end)] | map(select(. != "")) | join(" · ")'
